generation.prompt_exact:
Create ONE isolated white sage plant (Salvia apiana) as a complete production game sprite, on a genuinely transparent alpha background. High quality detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART, visibly crisp square pixel clusters, stepped contours and deliberate small pixel shading, not painted gradients or photographic cutout. Warm light from upper left, restrained silvery blue gray greens, subtle outline. Three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility, coherent environmental game object; no UI, text, birds or animals, backdrop, frame, or checkerboard.

White sage has a LOW basal mound of thick BROAD SILVER WHITE opposite leaves, with three to five very TALL, THIN, AIRY, SPARSELY BRANCHING FLOWER STALKS arising far above foliage. Tiny pale white-lavender flowers spaced along slender brownish stalk branches. Flower stems should be long open lines with visible empty air, not fat flowering leafy columns, dense lavender spikes, or foxglove towers. Show natural woody base and just a few tiny contact pebbles. Healthy flowering specimen. Every tiny stalk tip and leaf must fit fully within frame. Center plant at no more than 65 percent width and 75 percent height, with at least 12 percent transparent margin on ALL sides. Top flowers fully visible. No ground rectangle, no large cast shadow. One flattened whole sprite, not independent foliage/stalk layers. Calm refined botanical detail, birds remain scene focus.

tool_call_arguments.prompt:
Create a production sprite sheet of FOUR distinct Southern California native small plants for ChirpNeighbors. Actual detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with small crisp square pixel clusters and carefully stepped edges; restrained rich organic shading, subtle dark contour selectively, warm upper-left light, slight top visibility with three-quarter side garden view. Fine detailed premium environmental game art, not cartoons, chibi, low-detail icons, painterly blur, glossy 3D, or UI. These quiet plants support birds as scene focus; no birds or animals in this image.

Exactly four isolated full plant sprites arranged in a generous 2 by 2 grid on TRUE transparent alpha background, ideally 2048 by 2048 pixels. Keep all flowers and stems completely within their own separate quadrant with wide empty gutters and padding. No labels, text, borders, pots, plaques, panels, ground rectangles, checkerboard or decorative backdrop. Each plant stands at bottom center of its own quadrant with a visible natural root collar and only a few tiny contact pebbles, no large baked shadow. Match coherent camera/light. Composition uses canvas efficiently but plants never touch; fit each specimen to cell independently, these are not physical size comparisons.

UPPER LEFT: White sage (Salvia apiana), a low silver-white mound of broad thick opposite leaves, a few tall thin branching flowering stalks rise above mound carrying very small white-pale lavender flowers. Show the broad silvery leaves clearly; this is not a lavender bush and not Cleveland sage with violet whorls. Healthy flowering state, natural irregular silhouette.
UPPER RIGHT: California sagebrush (Artemisia californica), airy round woody shrub with extremely fine divided threadlike gray-green foliage and slender arching stems. The foliage has soft feathery appearance expressed through precise pixels, with visible woody structure at the base. No showy flowers. Healthy winter/spring foliage state. Distinct from sage broad leaves.
LOWER LEFT: California bush sunflower (Encelia californica), loose rounded branching shrub with rounded diamond-shaped medium green leaves, many thin branches, numerous yellow daisy flowers with dark brown disks spread naturally across upper crown. Not a tall agricultural sunflower, not gray-leaf desert brittlebush. Healthy winter/spring flowering state with individual flowers readable.
LOWER RIGHT: Showy penstemon (Penstemon spectabilis), an upright herbaceous clump of blue-violet tubular two-lipped flowers on tall multiple spikes, pale lavender to white throats, opposite lance-shaped to oval green leaves, a visible basal leafy clump; airy natural silhouette. Purple flowers should visibly be tubes, not lavender whorls. Healthy spring flowering state.

Deliver actual clean transparent sprites with detailed botanical structure, separate silhouettes, no caption. Crisp pixel art, not photographs. This is one flattened sheet of four separately extractable whole sprites, not independently layered stems and foliage.
